resources.string: Connect to a VM or lab running on your server.
A Linux server reached over SSH.
Enable SSH in DSM > Control Panel > Terminal & SNMP before connecting.
Connect to RouterOS on a real device or CHR on an external VM. It uses the RouterOS CLI, not a Linux shell.
The device must have SSH enabled and an account with the right privilege. It uses the device CLI, not a Linux shell.
Enable SSH on ESXi per your host\'s policy before using it. It uses the ESXi shell.
A Proxmox VE server over SSH. Manage VMs and containers with qm and pct from the node shell. The SSH host key is verified; credentials stay in the keychain.
A Docker host over SSH. Run docker commands on the host. The SSH host key is verified; credentials stay in the keychain.
